plan.rationale: Router authorized a merge of K3_C0002 and K3_C0003. Pair-scope structural diagnostics show intermediate-to-high normalized-cut cost (0.592), moderate two-way spectral ARI (0.698), and a union spectral structure dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1, leading eigengap 0.488), which is merge-compatible. Pair-scope affinity-geometry concordance shows near-zero mean silhouettes across all four native views (0.041-0.060) with substantial negative fractions (WSI 56.8%, WXS 41.9%, RNA 33.8%). Set-scope membership representation is weak and conflicting for K3_C0002 (only CT weakly positive at 0.052; RNA -0.062, WSI -0.119, WXS -0.076, with K3_C0003 the nearest competitor in all four views), while K3_C0003 is more coherent (all four views positive, WSI 0.303). The union is therefore more consistent with a single unit than with two independently represented sets. This is a provisional comparative revision; the merged set must re-establish its own identity and independence on return.

biological_support.dimension_interpretation: K3_C0001 shows a coherent, interpretable transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: coordinated up-regulation of immune/inflammatory and interferon programs (allograft rejection NES 2.61; IFN-gamma 2.28; IFN-alpha 2.17; IL6/JAK/STAT3 2.13; inflammatory response 1.83) alongside up-regulated proliferation (E2F 1.80; G2M 1.69), with down-regulation of UV-response-down (-2.12), protein secretion (-2.00), fatty-acid metabolism (-1.76), androgen response (-1.73), and bile-acid metabolism (-1.61). Directions and magnitudes are internally consistent across related pathways, and the leading-edge gene lists overlap heavily across the immune pathways, indicating a shared immune program rather than isolated signals. Multiplicity is addressed by FDR q values, with the strongest programs at q=0.001. This characterizes biological identity only; it does not establish that current membership or granularity deserves independent retention.
biological_support.cross_evidence_context: This is one of two reciprocal set-versus-rest contrasts in a two-set partition; the K3_C0002_M_K3_C0003 report is the mirror view of the same comparison and is not an independent biological confirmation. The prior structural-diagnostics report noted no dominant internal subdivision signal and relatively lower boundary affinity; that structural triage is separate from this biological characterization.
limitations: Two-set partition: the two set-versus-rest contrasts are reciprocal views of the same comparison, not independent confirmations.
Enrichment is relative to the rest of the current partition and does not establish clinical validity or action.
FDR q values reflect multiple-testing-adjusted enrichment evidence, not biological importance.
